decisions.sh_d1_first_leaf: gdn_input_projections: 4.11-4.17 ms/token and 17.28%-24.44% of hipEngine profiled GPU wall; active Q8T16 paired input projection is the largest exact short/mid weight role.
decisions.sh_d1_second_leaf: selected expert gate/up plus down: about 3.91-3.93 ms/token; fork selected Q4+Q5 is about 2.96-2.98 ms/token.
decisions.sh_a1_attention: full attention core grows from 1.58/0.91 to 4.53/8.04 ms/token; fork F16 FlashAttention is 0.19/0.66/3.40/6.39 ms/token and Q8 is 0.15/0.42/1.93/3.60 ms/token. Keep A1 gated behind D1, but the long-context residual is material.
decisions.sh_m1_first_screen: The physically-owned bulk-prefill scratch is 1.756-1.818 GiB at 4K-64K with 4096 rows. Screen 1024 rows first: a linear-size estimate saves about 1.32-1.36 GiB and clears the >=1.0 GiB campaign gate if prefill stays within 1%.
decisions.memory_scope: hipEngine whole-GTT now exceeds fork F16 by 1.085/2.391/2.205/2.071 GiB and fork Q8 by 1.084/2.299/2.575/2.704 GiB at 512/4K/32K/64K. This replaces the prior tracked-vs-GTT descriptive delta with same-scope sampling.

qualifications: Repeated-token development attribution only; retain changes only after natural category/heldout gates.
